premises.text: Idle cash in P2P apps earns returns for the apps, not users, while inflation erodes balances
premises.evidence_span: it's those same peer-to-peer apps that are benefiting from cash balances and earning a return, leaving nothing behind for their users

premises.text: Younger users want to grow wealth but lack time or resources to invest
premises.evidence_span: Millennials, Gen Z, all of us want to earn and grow our wealth, but sometimes just lack the resources, time, or energy or resources to invest

premises.text: Stacks turns peer-to-peer paybacks into stock transfers that build wealth each transaction
premises.evidence_span: the first peer-to-peer payment designed to generate wealth with every single transaction

premises.text: Backend holds cash until recipient accepts, then converts to chosen stock with cash alternative
premises.evidence_span: It only converts to stock once she clicks Accept in her Notifications tab

premises.text: Social public portfolios and transactions make investing less lonely and more transparent
premises.evidence_span: we make all portfolios and trades and transactions public, so you can like and comment on various transactions

premises.text: Brokerage partnership covers substantial cash and portfolio balances for user safety
premises.evidence_span: We cover up to 250K of user cash balances and 500K of portfolio investments using our brokerage partner, Alpaca

premises.text: Platform can extend beyond P2P into rideshare, registries, and business payment integrations
premises.evidence_span: we go beyond just peer-to-peer payments

value.text: Every payment becomes an investment that brings new users into the markets
value.evidence_span: allowing anyone to turn every payment into an investment

causal_links.evidence_span: leaving nothing behind for their users
generate wealth with every single transaction
